sole_frozen_prospective_authority.source: Christopher Skinner, A converse to a theorem of Gross, Zagier, and Kolyvagin, Annals of Mathematics 191 (2020), Section 2.2, pp. 337-338
sole_frozen_prospective_authority.frozen_packet_witness: The frozen actual_fibre_contents names Skinner 2020 Annals Sec.2.2 before candidate generation.
verified_source_effects: For W=V_pA_f/T_pA_f=A_f[p^infinity], each classical local Kummer condition is the image of the characteristic-zero Bloch-Kato H^1_f local condition.
The maximal divisible subgroup of the global p-infinity Selmer group is the image of the characteristic-zero Bloch-Kato Selmer group.
The ambient global V_p-to-W image is maximal divisible and has finite index; in the usual Selmer subgroup this gives finite quotient by the maximal divisible image.

post_freeze_corroboration.source: Chan-Ho Kim, On the soft p-converse to a theorem of Gross-Zagier and Kolyvagin, proof of Proposition 3.3
post_freeze_corroboration.observed_after_freeze: Kim states that the compact-kernel/cokernel argument for 0 -> T -> V -> V/T -> 0 applies to usual Selmer groups, explicitly recording the corank-one/dimension-one instance.

exact_coefficient_comparison.object: An elliptic curve E/Q and prime p, with T=T_pE, V=V_pE=T tensor_Zp Q_p, W=V/T=E[p^infinity], and the usual Kummer/Bloch-Kato Selmer structures.
exact_coefficient_comparison.local_condition_witness: Skinner identifies the W-valued Kummer local condition with the image of H^1_f(Q_v,V_pE) at every place, so phi has the claimed global target.
kernel_reason: The exact coefficient sequence gives a compact Z_p-submodule as kernel.
The image lies in a p-primary torsion group, so every source class has a p-power multiple in the kernel.
Therefore the compact kernel spans H^1_f(Q,V_pE) over Q_p and is a full Z_p-lattice.
exact_coefficient_comparison.quotient_reason: The usual p-infinity Selmer group is cofinitely generated over Z_p, and its quotient by its maximal divisible subgroup is finite; Skinner identifies im(phi) with that subgroup.
exact_coefficient_comparison.dimension_corank_reason: If d=dim_Qp H^1_f(Q,V_pE), quotienting by a full lattice gives a divisible p-primary group isomorphic noncanonically to (Q_p/Z_p)^d, hence corank d; the remaining finite quotient contributes zero corank.
exact_coefficient_comparison.proof_direction: COEFFICIENT_EQUALITY; when composed with Zhang R9, only the stored lower-bound implication analytic rank two -> dimension at least two is obtained.

scoped_corollary.statement: For the same E/Q and the same p>=5 satisfying all four hypotheses of Wei Zhang Theorem 1.4, ord_{s=1} L(E,s)=2 implies dim_Qp H^1_f(Q,V_pE)>=2.
zhang_hypotheses_preserved: rho_{E,p} is ramified at every prime l||N with l congruent to +/-1 modulo p
if N is not square-free, Ram(rho_{E,p}) is nonempty and, when it has size one, the number of primes l||N is even
p is good ordinary and p>=5
strict_nonclaims: no simultaneous statement for every prime p
